objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the SQL injection weakness of a job search with a GraphQL endpoint (Strawberry) over SQLite and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Find which input ends up inside the SQL query without being bound as a parameter.
Explore the GraphQL schema to see every query and argument available.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which injection class does the vulnerable query suffer from?

steps.title: Find the API
steps.prompt: Which API query language wraps the vulnerable search?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which API query language does the application expose?
